definitions.explanation: The formal ceremony held at the start of an event such as a sports tournament, school athletic festival, conference, or international competition. Typically includes speeches, parading of participants, and an official declaration that the event has begun.

examples.japanese: {開会式|かいかいしき}は{午前|ごぜん}{九|く}{時|じ}に{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: The opening ceremony starts at 9 a.m.

examples.japanese: オリンピックの{開会式|かいかいしき}をテレビで{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the Olympic opening ceremony on TV.

examples.japanese: {運動会|うんどうかい}の{開会式|かいかいしき}で、{校長先生|こうちょうせんせい}が{挨拶|あいさつ}をした。
examples.english: At the opening ceremony of the sports day, the principal gave a speech.

examples.japanese: {大会|たいかい}の{開会式|かいかいしき}では、{各|かく}{国|こく}の{選手団|せんしゅだん}が{順番|じゅんばん}に{入場|にゅうじょう}し、{大|おお}きな{歓声|かんせい}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: At the tournament's opening ceremony, the national teams entered in turn and were enveloped in loud cheers.

notes:
{開会式|かいかいしき} combines {開会|かいかい} (opening of a meeting/event) and {式|しき} (ceremony, formal event). It is the standard term for the opening ceremony of any organized event, from school sports days to the Olympics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開会式|かいかいしき}を{行|おこな}う: to hold an opening ceremony
- {開会式|かいかいしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する: to attend an opening ceremony
- {開会式|かいかいしき}で{挨拶|あいさつ}する: to give a speech at the opening ceremony
- {開会式|かいかいしき}の{司会|しかい}: master of ceremonies for the opening ceremony

ANTONYM:
- {閉会式|へいかいしき}: closing ceremony — held at the end of the same kind of event

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- {運動会|うんどうかい}の{開会式|かいかいしき}: opening ceremony of a school sports day
- オリンピックの{開会式|かいかいしき}: Olympic opening ceremony
- {学会|がっかい}の{開会式|かいかいしき}: opening ceremony of an academic conference
- {大会|たいかい}の{開会式|かいかいしき}: tournament opening ceremony

RELATED TERMS:
- {開会|かいかい}: opening (of a meeting/event)
- {式|しき}: ceremony, formal event
- {入場|にゅうじょう}{行進|こうしん}: parade of entry (a typical part of an opening ceremony)
- {選手宣誓|せんしゅせんせい}: athletes' oath
